messages.content: QA outputs. Flag unsupported claims and missing information. Return strict JSON.

parameters.query:
WITH warning_insert AS (
  INSERT INTO content_errors (job_id, severity, error_code, error_message, recoverable, context)
  SELECT NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid, 'warning', 'QA_PARSE_WARNING', COALESCE(NULLIF('{{$json.warning_message_sql}}',''),'LLM response parse warning'), true, jsonb_build_object('raw_text', LEFT('{{$json.raw_model_text_sql}}', 2000), 'workflow', '{{$json.current_stage_sql}}')
  WHERE COALESCE('{{$json.parse_warning}}','false') = 'true'
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','') AS job_id, '{{$json.qa_report_json_b64}}' AS qa_report_json_b64, '{{$json.mode}}' AS mode;

WITH qa AS (
  SELECT convert_from(decode('{{$json.qa_report_json_b64}}','base64'),'UTF8')::jsonb AS report
), issues AS (
  SELECT issue
  FROM qa, jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(report->'issues','[]'::jsonb)) AS issue
), summary AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*)::int AS issue_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE((issue->>'repairable')::boolean,false))::int AS repairable_issue_count,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT COALESCE((issue->>'repairable')::boolean,false))::int AS blocking_issue_count,
    COALESCE(NULLIF((SELECT report->'repair_summary'->>'max_repair_attempts' FROM qa), '')::int, 2) AS max_repair_attempts
  FROM issues
), target_outputs AS (
  SELECT id, output_type, structured_data
  FROM content_outputs
  WHERE job_id=NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid
    AND qa_status='pending'
    AND output_type NOT IN ('qa_report','delivery_pack','tool_execution_plan','request_analysis','asset_index')
), qa_insert AS (
  INSERT INTO content_outputs (job_id, output_type, title, structured_data, qa_status)
  VALUES (
    NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid,
    'qa_report',
    'QA report',
    (SELECT report FROM qa),
    CASE WHEN (SELECT blocking_issue_count FROM summary) > 0 THEN 'needs_human_review' ELSE 'passed' END
  )
  RETURNING id
), repair_attempts AS (
  INSERT INTO content_repair_attempts (job_id, output_id, repair_type, issue_code, status, max_attempts, input_payload, output_payload, completed_at)
  SELECT
    NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid,
    target_outputs.id,
    COALESCE(NULLIF(issues.issue->>'repair_type',''),'safe_content_repair'),
    COALESCE(NULLIF(issues.issue->>'issue_code',''),'qa_repair'),
    CASE WHEN (SELECT blocking_issue_count FROM summary) = 0 THEN 'completed' ELSE 'queued' END,
    (SELECT max_repair_attempts FROM summary),
    jsonb_build_object('issue', issues.issue, 'output_before', target_outputs.structured_data),
    CASE WHEN (SELECT blocking_issue_count FROM summary) = 0
      THEN jsonb_build_object('repair_action','annotated_safe_repair','output_type',target_outputs.output_type)
      ELSE '{}'::jsonb
    END,
    CASE WHEN (SELECT blocking_issue_count FROM summary) = 0 THEN now() ELSE NULL END
  FROM target_outputs, issues
  WHERE COALESCE((issues.issue->>'repairable')::boolean,false)
  RETURNING id
), output_update AS (
  UPDATE content_outputs
  SET qa_status = CASE
      WHEN (SELECT issue_count FROM summary) = 0 THEN 'passed'
      WHEN (SELECT blocking_issue_count FROM summary) = 0 THEN 'repaired'
      ELSE 'needs_human_review'
    END,
    structured_data = CASE
      WHEN (SELECT repairable_issue_count FROM summary) > 0 AND (SELECT blocking_issue_count FROM summary) = 0
        THEN structured_data || jsonb_build_object('qa_repair', jsonb_build_object('status','repaired','repair_attempt_ids',(SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(id),'[]'::jsonb) FROM repair_attempts)))
      ELSE structured_data
    END,
    updated_at=now()
  WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM target_outputs)
  RETURNING id
), job_update AS (
  UPDATE content_jobs SET status='waiting_for_human_review', updated_at=now() WHERE id=NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid RETURNING id
), event_insert AS (
  INSERT INTO content_events (job_id,event_type,message,metadata)
  VALUES (
    NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid,
    CASE WHEN (SELECT repairable_issue_count FROM summary) > 0 THEN 'qa_repair' ELSE 'approval_gate' END,
    CASE WHEN (SELECT repairable_issue_count FROM summary) > 0 AND (SELECT blocking_issue_count FROM summary) = 0 THEN 'Repairable QA issues were automatically repaired' ELSE 'Final delivery approval gate reached' END,
    jsonb_build_object('approval_stage','final_delivery','human_only',true,'qa_report_id',(SELECT id FROM qa_insert),'issue_count',(SELECT issue_count FROM summary),'repairable_issue_count',(SELECT repairable_issue_count FROM summary),'blocking_issue_count',(SELECT blocking_issue_count FROM summary),'repair_attempt_count',(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM repair_attempts))
  )
)
SELECT NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','') AS job_id,
       'waiting_for_human_review' AS status,
       (SELECT issue_count FROM summary) AS qa_issue_count,
       (SELECT repairable_issue_count FROM summary) AS repairable_issue_count,
       (SELECT blocking_issue_count FROM summary) AS blocking_issue_count,
       (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM repair_attempts) AS repair_attempt_count,
       '{{$json.mode}}' AS mode,
       ('{{$json.mode}}'='live') AS live_mode;

WITH job AS (
  SELECT id, COALESCE(approval_policy,'full_staged') AS approval_policy
  FROM content_jobs WHERE id=NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid
), latest_qa AS (
  SELECT structured_data
  FROM content_outputs
  WHERE job_id=(SELECT id FROM job) AND output_type='qa_report'
  ORDER BY created_at DESC
  LIMIT 1
), unresolved AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*)::int AS blocking_issue_count
  FROM latest_qa, jsonb_array_elements(COALESCE(structured_data->'issues','[]'::jsonb)) AS issue
  WHERE NOT COALESCE((issue->>'repairable')::boolean,false)
)
SELECT CASE
    WHEN (SELECT COALESCE(blocking_issue_count,0) FROM unresolved) > 0 THEN false
    WHEN (SELECT approval_policy FROM job) IN ('none','qa_only') THEN true
    ELSE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM content_approvals WHERE job_id=(SELECT id FROM job) AND approval_stage='final_delivery' AND decision='approved' AND reviewer_type='human')
  END AS final_human_approved,
  '{{$json.job_id}}' AS job_id,
  '{{$json.mode}}' AS mode,
  ('{{$json.mode}}'='live') AS live_mode,
  (SELECT approval_policy FROM job) AS approval_policy,
  (SELECT COALESCE(blocking_issue_count,0) FROM unresolved) AS blocking_issue_count;

WITH outputs AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('output_type', output_type, 'title', title, 'qa_status', qa_status, 'structured_data', structured_data) ORDER BY created_at), '[]'::jsonb) AS included_outputs
  FROM content_outputs WHERE job_id=NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid AND output_type <> 'delivery_pack'
), drive AS (
  SELECT NULLIF(NULLIF('{{$json.id}}','undefined'),'') AS drive_file_id
), pack AS (
  INSERT INTO content_outputs (job_id, output_type, title, structured_data, qa_status, drive_file_id)
  VALUES (
    NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid,
    'delivery_pack',
    'Delivery pack',
    jsonb_build_object(
      'delivery_ready', true,
      'generated_after_human_approval', true,
      'included_outputs', (SELECT included_outputs FROM outputs),
      'drive_upload_response', COALESCE((SELECT drive_file_id FROM drive), ''),
      'drive_upload_skipped', (SELECT drive_file_id FROM drive) IS NULL
    ),
    'passed',
    (SELECT drive_file_id FROM drive)
  )
  RETURNING id
), event_insert AS (
  INSERT INTO content_events (job_id,event_type,message,metadata)
  VALUES (NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid,'delivery_pack_ready','Delivery pack created',jsonb_build_object('delivery_pack_id',(SELECT id FROM pack),'drive_upload_skipped',(SELECT drive_file_id FROM drive) IS NULL))
), job_update AS (
  UPDATE content_jobs SET status='delivery_ready', updated_at=now() WHERE id=NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','')::uuid RETURNING id
)
SELECT NULLIF('{{$json.job_id}}','') AS job_id, 'delivery_ready' AS status, (SELECT id::text FROM pack) AS delivery_pack_id;
